summary:
Iter 614 (Rakip Yorum Zekâsı + Ödül Duvarı + Görev Kapanış Etkisi). BACKEND (6/6 pytest passing, test_iter614.py): (1) GET /api/reputation/competitor-intel/default → mode='simulated', competitors[{name,mode,reviews_analyzed,strengths,weaknesses,amenities_praised,they_have_we_dont}] with 1 comp (Competitor Regression), they_have_we_dont[{item,competitors,action}], their_strength_our_weakness, our_weak_topics, our_strong_topics, insight text present. (2) GET /api/reviews/staff-praise/leaderboard?property_id=default → weekly_stars[], badges: Sarah weeks_won=1 (dedup by (staff,week) works even though staff_praise_log has multiple same-week entries), badges include '⭐ Haftanın Yıldızı'; monthly_leaderboard rows have name/rank/positive/negative/avg_rating. (3) GET /api/my-tasks → root_cause_tasks[] with source='root_cause' status open; picked first id → PUT /api/my-tasks/staff-task/{id}/complete {notes:'test complete'} → 200 {ok:true,status:'done'}; re-GET confirms id gone. Unknown id → 404. (4) POST /api/reviews/root-cause/impact/run?property_id=default → {ok:true, reported:int, reports:[]} (0 today, expected since newly closed <30d); GET /api/reviews/root-cause/impact?property_id=all → items[] non-empty, contains a topic='staff' row with verdict='improved', before/after each carry topic_avg_rating & negative_pct. (5) /api/automation/settings response contains both 'root_cause_impact' and 'staff_praise_weekly' job keys.
FRONTEND (all pass): login admin → nav-mode-pro. (a) my-tasks-btn → reward-wall visible; reward-badges shows reward-badge-Sarah 'Sarah 1× · 2026-W36 ⭐ Haftanın Yıldızı'; monthly-leaderboard with leader-1 (Sarah), leader-2 (Mehmet), leader-3 (John). root-cause-tasks-section with 3 open rc-task-complete-* buttons; clicking one → toast 'Görev kapatıldı — 30 gün sonra etkisi raporlanır' and the row disappears (verified count=0 after). (b) analytics-btn → analytics-competitors-tab → competitor-intel-card + SIMULATED context, competitor-intel-insight 'Rakipler staff konularında güçlü, biz zayıfız. Onlarda var bizde yok: free parking, free breakfast, balcony, sea view.', they-have-we-dont block, competitor-intel-Competitor Regression card (Güçlü/Zayıf/Övülen olanaklar). (c) analytics-sentiment-tab → root-cause-card with root-cause-impact block; root-cause-impact-run-btn click → toast '0 görev etkisi raporlandı'; impact-staff row rendered: 'staff (8/4/2026) 4.33★ → —★ · olumsuz %10 → %0 · improved'. No console errors beyond expected pre-login 401.
critical_code_review_comments: staff_leaderboard correctly deduplicates by (staff, week) tuple before incrementing weeks_won — verified Sarah=1 despite multiple same-week rows in staff_praise_log.
run_root_cause_impact_internal uses impact_reported_at exists-check as idempotency guard and requires completed_at/updated_at ≤ cutoff (30d), so newly closed tasks correctly report 0 — good.
complete_staff_task returns HTTP 404 with detail 'Task not found' when id unknown — spec compliant.
competitor_intel _sim_competitor_reviews uses deterministic sha1(name) seed so simulated output is reproducible across test runs — great for regression.

AMENITY_KW 'ev charging' regex `\bev\b|charging|şarj` — `\bev\b` will match generic word 'ev' in Turkish (meaning 'home'), which could produce false positives in future review text; consider `ev charging|ev şarj` instead. Non-blocking.
JOB_REGISTRY includes both root_cause_impact and staff_praise_weekly — surfaced via /api/automation/settings.
seed_data_creation: None new — used existing seeded staff_praise_log (Sarah), reputation_config (Competitor Regression) and root_cause_impacts (staff/improved) records. During the test one open root_cause staff_task was completed via PUT — main agent should be aware that count of open root_cause tasks decreases by 1 on subsequent runs (self-cleaning by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 614 fully green. Reward Wall lives in MyTasksPanel (my-tasks-btn under Dashboard section) with testids reward-wall / reward-badges / reward-badge-{name} / monthly-leaderboard / leader-{rank}. Root cause tasks under root-cause-tasks-section with rc-task-complete-{id}. Analytics Competitors tab: competitor-intel-card / competitor-intel-insight / they-have-we-dont / competitor-intel-{competitorName}. Analytics Sentiment tab: root-cause-card wraps root-cause-impact block, run button root-cause-impact-run-btn, per-topic row impact-{topic}. Automation JOB_REGISTRY has root_cause_impact & staff_praise_weekly keys.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iter 614 backend and frontend paths function per spec.
